selection_definition.counts_as_result: Exactly the four unnumbered Section 2 headline theorems and every named theorem, proposition, lemma, and corollary that Davis--Kahan actually establish in this paper.
selection_definition.statement_boundary: Only hypotheses, conclusions, and scope that belong to the printed result statement count. Setup, proof steps, examples, immediate consequences, extension remarks, and later restatements remain source-fidelity material unless they are themselves one of the designated results.
does_not_count: sharpness or interpretation commentary outside a designated result
immediate consequences or scope remarks outside the printed result environment
Section 10 open questions and their motivating special cases
claims explicitly left unresolved or whose proof is deferred to an open question
later proof-section restatements of a result already counted at its source statement
selection_definition.false_printed_result_policy: A designated result that is false remains in the denominator and is completed by exact formal refutation plus the repository best-effort repair obligation.

results.review_note: RE-CLOSED 2026-08-12 after repair (reopened earlier the same day; the reopening is retained in git history).  The defect was real: the registered unbounded directed endpoint `unbounded_sinTwoTheta_residual_uiNorm_representative` bounds delta * N(sin 2Theta_0) by the norm of a self-adjoint REFLECTION residual satisfying (A + R) J_V = J_V A, which is not the printed residual (1.8). There is no finite-dimensionality, compactness, acuteness, separability, self-adjointness-of-R or reflection hypothesis visible to the caller: the reflected comparison system D = -2 (X + X*) is constructed internally from the trial data by `trialReflection_intertwines`.  The sharp factor two is obtained blockwise from the scalar-generic doubling identity `kyFan_reflectionDefectBlock_le_two_mul`, not from a triangle inequality on the reflection defect, which would give four.  The complex spectral-separation hypotheses are the printed interval/exterior separation stated through semiboundedness plus resolvent-set avoidance; the real endpoint carries the scalar-generic `FormBoundedSylvesterGap`, which is the weaker predicate (hence the stronger theorem) and covers all three printed separation configurations, and `..._paperUINorm_real_of_intervalExterior` restates it at the printed interval/exterior separation itself.  The ambient conclusion delta * N(sin 2Theta) <= 2 N(H) remains covered over both fields by `sinTwoTheta_wholeSpace_paperUINorm` and `sinTwoTheta_wholeSpace_paperUINorm_real`.
